product_one_liner.value: SMS-Magic provides CRM-integrated, multichannel business messaging for sales and marketing representatives and customer-service agents.
product_one_liner.notes: The product overview describes multichannel business messaging and identifies sales and marketing representatives and service agents as its target users: https://www.sms-magic.co/docs/salesforce/knowledge-base/overview-2. The documentation hub establishes its Salesforce and Zoho integrations: https://www.sms-magic.com/docs.

pricing_page.notes: A public pricing page exists at https://pricing.sms-magic.com/.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Official customer case studies document Upstart and Renault using SMS-Magic: https://www.sms-magic.com/case-studies/upstart and https://www.sms-magic.com/case-studies/how-renault-used-sms-magic-to-provide-excellent-customer-service-via-text-messaging. | named_customers.0: The official Upstart case study describes its use of personalized contextual messaging. | named_customers.1: The official Renault case study describes its customer-service messaging use case.

employee_band.notes: A headcount record reports 312 employees, which maps to 201-500, and a public profile explicitly lists the same band: http://prospeo.io/c/sms-magic-email-format. Confidence is reduced because LinkedIn displays a conflicting smaller range.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The official contact page identifies Henderson as the Global/USA Headquarters city: https://www.sms-magic.com/contact. This explicit designation is preferred over conflicting Pune wording elsewhere. | hq_country: The official contact page labels the Henderson, Nevada address Global/USA Headquarters: https://www.sms-magic.com/contact. This designation is preferred over conflicting Pune-headquarters wording on the careers page.

founded_year.notes: SMS-Magic's company profile explicitly states Founded 2008: https://linkedin.com/company/1110444.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index contains marketing, messaging best-practice and product-tutorial posts, rather than two engineer-authored posts about building the product: https://www.sms-magic.com/blog.

public_docs.notes: The public technical resource center provides separate user and administrator guides and additional Zoho documentation, rather than a lone FAQ: https://www.sms-magic.com/docs.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official job board lists 11 open positions, none with a qualifying AI, ML, machine-learning, data-science, scientist, NLP, LLM or computer-vision title: https://screenmagic.keka.com/careers.

model_provider.value: OpenAI (through a documented integration using customer-connected models and API keys)
model_provider.notes: The product documentation explicitly supports connecting existing OpenAI models through an API key and optional Assistant ID: https://docs.sms-magic.com/rX9XdO2FY0Q-sms-magic-converse-salesforce-app/6ReFmf74mPA-faq-bot. This establishes a supported provider, not necessarily the default backend for every AI feature.

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The official security documentation explicitly claims compliance with ISO 27001:2013, HIPAA and GDPR, without describing them as in progress: https://www.sms-magic.co/docs/portal/knowledge-base/data-security. These are public claims, not an independent validation of certification status. | compliance_certs.0: The official security page explicitly includes ISO 27001:2013 in its claimed compliance certifications. | compliance_certs.1: HIPAA is explicitly listed under the company's compliance statement. | compliance_certs.2: GDPR is explicitly listed under the company's compliance statement.

raised_18mo.notes: The company funding profile reports no funding rounds, supporting no recorded raise during the requested 18 months: https://tracxn.com/d/companies/smsmagic/__0qMYDPUNZVLCEDpJbirbmIIz5GgrEw4pEQphoXwcajw.

launched_6mo.notes: The official changelog announces inbound calling through the Conversive browser softphone on October 19, 2026, within the requested six-month window: https://sms-magic.canny.io/changelog. Official company hiring material identifies Conversive as formerly SMS-Magic: https://screenmagic.keka.com/careers/jobdetails/93084.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The available leadership listing is explicitly unverified and covers only two people, without joining or departure dates: https://theorg.com/org/sms-magic/teams/leadership-team. It does not establish a complete, dated leadership history for the requested window, so neither true nor false is supported.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The official documentation hub names Salesforce and Zoho and provides dedicated integration documentation: https://www.sms-magic.com/docs.
